TuneJury：改进的开放指标TuneJury: An Open Metric for Improving
音乐生成偏好调整Music Generation Preference Alignment

Yonghyun Kim♯
&Junwon Lee♭♭
&Haiwen Xia♮♮
&Yinghao Ma♯♯
Junghyun Koo♮
&Koichi Saito♮
&Yuki Mitsufuji♮
&Chris Donahue♭
& ♭Carnegie Mellon University    ♮Sony AI    ♯Georgia Tech ♭♭KAIST    ♮♮Peking University    ♯♯QMUL
摘要Abstract

我们介绍We introduce曲调评审团TuneJury，一种用于文本到音乐的开放式实例级成对奖励模型，可根据文本提示和音频剪辑预测音乐偏好分数。发布的检查点是根据公开的人类偏好标签进行训练的，这些标签涵盖竞技场式（A 与 B）投票、度量对齐偏好对、众包成对比较和专家审美评级。两个剪辑之间的预测分数差距在我们保留的测试分割上得到了很好的校准，支持通过简单的分数阈值进行数据过滤。 TuneJury 概括了保留的测试对和分布外基准，与后者的先前基准保持竞争力。对于训练后发布的生成器，我们引入, an open, instance-level pairwise reward model for text-to-music that predicts a music preference score from a text prompt and an audio clip. The released checkpoint is trained on publicly available human-preference labels covering arena-style (A vs. B) votes, metric-alignment preference pairs, crowdsourced pairwise comparisons, and expert aesthetic ratings. The predicted score margin between two clips is well calibrated on our held-out test split, supporting data filtering via a simple score threshold. TuneJury generalizes to both held-out test pairs and out-of-distribution benchmarks, remaining competitive with prior baselines on the latter. For generators released after training, we introduce锚定标定anchor calibration，一种事后的、针对每个系统的 Bradley-Terry 校准，与从头开始的再训练相比，它以更高的数据效率恢复了一致性。相同的冻结奖励在三个下游应用程序中驱动一致的奖励轴增益：推理时间最佳-, a post-hoc, per-system Bradley–Terry calibration that recovers agreement at substantially better data efficiency than from-scratch retraining. The same frozen reward drives consistent reward-axis gains across three downstream applications: inference-time best-of-NN选择、DITTO 式潜在优化和专家迭代后训练。selection, DITTO-style latent optimization, and expert-iteration post-training.

TuneJury 的网址为：TuneJury is available athttps://github.com/yonghyunk1m/TuneJury.

1 简介Introduction

音乐偏好是主观的Music preference is subjective[10]，这使得文本转音乐（TTM）评估变得困难。流行的指标，例如 Fréchet 音频距离 (FAD), which makes text-to-music (TTM) evaluation difficult. Popular metrics such as Fréchet audio distance (FAD)[30]及其特定于编码器的变体and its encoder-specific variants[21]不直接解决这个问题：它们测量编码器空间与参考集的相似性而不是人类偏好，并且它们描述集合而不是单个剪辑do not address this directly: they measure encoder-space similarity to a reference set rather than human preference, and they describe collections rather than individual clips[25]。即使是同一个 TTM 系统，一代一代的产品质量也各不相同。要选择听众喜欢哪一代，跟踪模型在提示和流派中的表现，或者选择下一步要微调的样本，我们需要. Even the same TTM system produces variable quality from one generation to the next. To choose which generation a listener prefers, to track how the model performs across prompts and genres, or to pick which samples to fine-tune on next, we need a每个剪辑per-clip反映人类偏好的评价指标。绝对平均意见得分 (MOS) 回归，是相邻音频领域（例如语音）中使用的替代方案evaluation metric that reflects human preference. Absolute mean opinion score (MOS) regression, an alternative used in adjacent audio domains such as speech[41]，一次为一个片段评分。然而，对于任何主观评级任务来说，评估者共享一个量表的假设都是脆弱的：量表会随着会话和个人的变化而变化, does score clips one at a time. However, its assumption that raters share a scale is fragile for any subjective rating task: scales drift across sessions and individuals[55, 12]。这种倾向对于音乐来说尤其强烈，因为音乐的偏好取决于个人品味。因此，绝对回归器将这种漂移作为系统噪声继承。成对 A 与 B 比较完全避免了共享尺度假设：每个评分者都保持在自己的尺度内，产生的测量方差比直接评分更低. This drift is especially strong for music, where preference depends on individual taste. An absolute regressor therefore inherits this drift as systematic noise. Pairwise A vs. B comparison avoids the shared-scale assumption altogether: each rater stays within their own scale, yielding lower measurement variance than direct rating[47]。成对建模将偏好捕获为群体水平的概率而不是绝对质量，这就是主观信号承认明确定义的分数的方式。. Pairwise modeling captures preference as a population-level probability rather than an absolute quality, which is how a subjective signal admits a well-defined score.

通过这种比较来预测人类偏好的模型是A model trained on such comparisons to predict human preference is a奖励模式reward model。该设计被引入深度强化学习. The design was introduced in deep reinforcement learning[8]现在是语言模型对齐的标准，它为来自人类反馈的强化学习提供训练信号and is now standard in language model alignment, where it supplies the training signal for reinforcement learning from human feedback[51]。该范式最近达到了语音自然度判断（SpeechJudge. The paradigm has recently reached speech naturalness judgment (SpeechJudge[68]）。在音乐领域，最直接可比的先前工作是 CMI-RewardModel (CMI-RM)，来自 CMI-RewardBench). In music, the most directly comparable prior work is CMI-RewardModel (CMI-RM), from CMI-RewardBench[44]。据我们所知，CMI-RM 是唯一一个使用 RankNet 的共享权重配对逻辑设置训练的现有音乐奖励模型. To our knowledge, CMI-RM is the only existing music reward model trained with the shared-weight pairwise-logistic setup of RankNet[6]。它使用文本、歌词、参考音频和候选音频，并带有. It consumes text, lyrics, reference audio, and candidate audio, with a22-轴（对齐、质量）输出，经过培训-axis (alignment, quality) output, trained on∼110{\sim}110K LLM 伪标签增强K LLM pseudo-labels augmented with∼6.6{\sim}6.6K 人类提供的对。这就提出了两个自然问题。首先，K human-provided pairs. This raises two natural questions. First,仅对（提示、音频）数据点进行评分而没有歌词或参考音频的更精简的奖励模型在同一任务上的表现如何？how well can a leaner reward model that scores only (prompt, audio) data points, without lyrics or reference audio, perform on the same task?第二，Second,在没有伪标签增强的情况下对人类进行训练的模型能否达到有竞争力的准确性？can a model trained on human pairs without pseudo-label augmentation reach competitive accuracy?

奖励模型训练完成后，新的TTM系统不断发布。来自不同系统的音乐具有不同的特征（音色、混音、风格选择），因此在现有系统上训练的奖励模型可能会对来自新系统的音乐进行统一高于或低于其训练音阶的评分。传统上，重新调整新系统的分数需要使用新的人类评分进行重新训练，这是昂贵的。我们另外介绍一下After a reward model is trained, new TTM systems keep being released. Music from different systems carries different characteristics (timbre, mixing, style choices), so a reward model trained on existing systems may score music from a new system uniformly above or below its trained scale. Realigning the new system’s scores traditionally requires retraining with fresh human ratings, which is expensive. All artifacts (checkpoints, code, demos) are openly released (AppendixI).

2 相关工作Related Work

音乐奖励模型。Music reward models.

RankNet [6]引入了共享权重配对逻辑学习排序公式，该公式被随后的文本到图像偏好奖励模型广泛采用introduced the shared-weight pairwise-logistic learning-to-rank formulation, widely adopted by subsequent text-to-image preference reward models[65, 33, 63]。在音乐奖励模型中，我们所知的唯一采用相同设置的先前工作是 CMI-RM. Within music reward modeling, the only prior work we are aware of that adopts the same setup is CMI-RM[44]，它通过文本、歌词、参考音频和候选音频的共享主干传递一对候选音频。我们使用非成对目标进行基准测试的其他四个音乐奖励模型：多轴 MOS 回归（Audiobox-Aesthetics, which passes both candidates of a pair through a shared backbone over text, lyrics, reference audio, and candidate audio. The four other music reward models we benchmark against use non-pairwise objectives: multi-axis MOS regression (Audiobox-Aesthetics[61], SongEval-RM [67]和 MuQ 评估, and MuQ-Eval[69]）和音频语言模型的零样本提示（PAM 分数) and zero-shot prompting of an audio-language model (PAM score[15]）。表). Table1总结了 TuneJury 的四个轴（框架、输入范围、输出结构、监督）。与 CMI-RewardBench 测试分组中所有五个基线相比的头对头数据显示在部分中summarizes how TuneJury sits along four axes (framework, input scope, output structure, supervision). Head-to-head numbers against all five baselines on the CMI-RewardBench test splits appear in Section4.2。 TuneJury 与 CMI-RM 共享成对范式，删除 CMI-RM 的歌词和参考音频通道，输出单个偏好标量而不是多轴向量或对齐质量对，并汇集四个开放的人类评级源，无需伪标签增强。. TuneJury shares the pairwise paradigm with CMI-RM, drops CMI-RM’s lyrics and reference-audio channels, outputs a single preference scalar instead of a multi-axis vector or alignment-quality pair, and pools four open human-rated sources without pseudo-label augmentation.

打开音乐偏好数据。Open music preference data.

我们汇集的四个开放人类标记源均于 2025 年新发布，它们是 Music ArenaThe four open human-labeled sources we pool, all newly released in 2025, are Music Arena[31]（现场竞技场两两对战），MusicPrefs(live arena pairwise battles), MusicPrefs[25]（保真度和音乐性轴上的成对偏好），AIME(pairwise preferences across fidelity and musicality axes), AIME[20]（众包成对比较）和 SongEval(crowdsourced pairwise comparisons), and SongEval[67] (55-轴专业音乐家的审美评级）。 CMI-奖励基准-axis aesthetic ratings by professional musicians). CMI-RewardBench[44]是音乐奖励模型的基准，伴随着 CMI-RM。我们的 Music Arena 训练池与 CMI-RewardBench 的 Music Arena 重叠 测试分割，在训练发布的检查点之前我们从池中删除的重叠 （节is a benchmark for music reward models, accompanied by CMI-RM. Our Music Arena training pool overlaps CMI-RewardBench’s Music Arena test split, an overlap we remove from our pool before training the released checkpoint (Section4.2、附录, AppendixD).

用于文本到音乐生成的其他自动化指标。Other automated metrics for text-to-music generation.

当前指标主要分为三组Current metrics fall mainly into three groups[43, 35]。 (一). (i)分布相似性Distributional similarity，以FAD为主, dominated by FAD[30]（音频嵌入空间中的 Fréchet 距离）及其特定于编码器的变体（FAD-CLAP、FAD-MERT 等）(a Fréchet distance in audio embedding space) and its encoder-specific variants (FAD-CLAP, FAD-MERT, etc.[21]），通常与 MusicGen 中音频分类器 logits 上的 KL 散度配对), typically paired with KL divergence on audio-classifier logits in MusicGen[13]/ 音频LDM2/ AudioLDM2[40]/ 稳定音频打开/ Stable Audio Open[16]评估，使用内核音频距离 (KAD)evaluation, with Kernel Audio Distance (KAD)[9]和 MAUVE 音频发散 (MAD)and MAUVE Audio Divergence (MAD)[25]作为最近的替代品。 (二)as recent alternatives. (ii)文本音频对齐Text-audio alignment，依赖于 CLAP 分数, relying on the CLAP score[64]。 (三). (iii)无参考质量预测No-reference quality prediction，例如Audiobox-Aesthetics, such as Audiobox-Aesthetics[61]和 PAM 分数and PAM score[15].

偏好学习和奖励驱动的培训后。Preference learning and reward-driven post-training.

直接偏好优化 (DPO)Direct preference optimization (DPO)[54]和 DPO 风格的音频对应项（例如 Tango 2and DPO-style audio counterparts (e.g., Tango 2[45], 探戈流, TangoFlux[28]）根据外部偏好标签调整生成模型。扩散模型的奖励驱动微调分为策略梯度方法（在不区分采样器的情况下估计采样奖励的更新），包括去噪扩散策略优化（DDPO）) align generative models against external preference labels. Reward-driven fine-tuning for diffusion models splits into policy-gradient methods (estimating updates from sampled rewards without differentiating the sampler), including denoising diffusion policy optimization (DDPO)[3]和DPOKand DPOK[17]，以及奖励反向传播方法（通过采样链区分奖励），包括 DRaFT, and reward-backprop methods (differentiating the reward through the sampling chain), including DRaFT[11]和 ReFLand ReFL[65]。组相关策略优化 (GRPO). Group-relative policy optimization (GRPO)[56]，为语言模型推理而引入，最近被用作扩散设置中的另一个策略梯度选项, introduced for language model reasoning, has more recently been applied as another policy-gradient option in the diffusion setting[66]。单独的工作线仅使用模型自己的样本和冻结的奖励信号，涵盖推理时间选择、潜在优化和自身样本微调：最佳-. A separate line of work uses only the model’s own samples and a frozen reward signal, spanning inference-time selection, latent optimization, and own-sample fine-tuning: best-of-NN选择（模式 1，文本到图像的标准selection (Mode 1, standard in text-to-image[65]和语言and language[18]），同上), DITTO[50]推理时潜在优化（模式 2，通过采样器反向传播到噪声潜在）和专家迭代inference-time latent optimization (Mode 2, backprop through the sampler into the noise latents), and expert iteration[2]（模式 3），其 LLM 领域变体包括奖励排名自我训练 (ReST)(Mode 3), whose LLM-domain variants include reward-ranked self-training (ReST)[22, 57]。模式 1–3（部分. Modes 1–3 (Section5）使用冻结的 TuneJury 奖励作为他们唯一的监督信号。不收集额外的人类偏好标签。) use the frozen TuneJury reward as their only supervision signal. No additional human preference labels are collected.

3 曲调评审团TuneJury

TuneJury 是一个用于文本转音乐的实例级成对奖励模型。小型 MLP 头读取冻结的音频和文本嵌入，并将单个（提示、音频）数据点映射到标量偏好分数，并使用共享权重配对逻辑目标对人类 A 与 B 判断进行训练，并在 CMI-RewardBench 上进行竞争（第 1 节）TuneJury is an instance-level pairwise reward model for text-to-music. A small MLP head reads frozen audio and text embeddings and maps a single (prompt, audio) data point to a scalar preference score, trained with the shared-weight pairwise-logistic objective on human A vs. B judgments and competitive on CMI-RewardBench (Section4）。我们描述了输入和头部架构、冻结的编码器堆栈及其对编码器选择的鲁棒性、四个开放的人类评级训练源以及成对训练过程。). We describe the inputs and head architecture, the frozen encoder stack and its robustness to the encoder choice, the four open human-rated training sources, and the pairwise training procedure.

对于 TuneJury 来说，文本提示是可选的：该指标可以单独为音频输入生成分数。我们将这一功能用于 SongEval，它发布音频和美学评级，但不发布用于生成音频的提示：它的文本分支接收Text prompts are optional for TuneJury: the metric can produce a score for an audio input alone. We use this capability for SongEval, which releases audio and aesthetic ratings but not the prompts used to generate the audio: its text branch receives a512512-d 训练期间的零向量。其他三个源发布提示，我们通过 CLAP 文本编码器提供提示。一个细微差别：MusicPrefs 注释者在没有看到提示的情况下对配对进行评分-d zero vector during training. The other three sources release prompts, which we feed through the CLAP text encoder. 音乐性与文本对齐不对称。Musicality vs. text-alignment asymmetry.

TuneJury 与 PAM 音乐性 MOS 的相关性比与文本对齐 MOS 的相关性更强 (SRCCTuneJury correlates much more strongly with PAM’s musicality MOS than with its text-alignment MOS (SRCC0.6100.610与vs.0.2530.253）。这部分反映了训练标签：竞技场风格的 A 与 B 偏好（Music Arena、AIME）将多个评估者考虑因素合并为一个获胜者，MusicPrefs 从其注释中排除对齐). This partly reflects the training labels: arena-style A vs. B preferences (Music Arena, AIME) collapse multiple rater considerations into one winner, MusicPrefs excludes alignment from its annotation[25]，而 SongEval 仅对美学轴进行评分。在这些标签上训练的标量会学习单个复合轴，并且 PAM 表明复合倾向于音乐性而不是对齐。这种不对称是否反映了评估者更重视音乐性，或者从音频嵌入中读取音乐性比从联合文本音频嵌入中读取对齐更容易，从这些折叠的标签中仍然无法识别。, and SongEval rates aesthetic axes only. A scalar trained on these labels learns a single composite axis, and PAM shows that composite leans toward musicality rather than alignment. Whether this asymmetry reflects raters weighting musicality more heavily, or musicality being easier to read from audio embeddings than alignment is from joint text-audio embeddings, remains unidentifiable from these collapsed labels.

(i) The real vs. AI calibration signal in the training mix is sparse: only AIME[20]包含真实音乐对（通过其 MTG-Jamendocontains real-music pairs (via its MTG-Jamendo[4]子集），即使有 AIME 众包工作者也更喜欢真实而不是人工智能，仅略高于机会（MTG-Jamendo 真实音频基线获胜subset), and even there AIME crowdworkers preferred real over AI only weakly above chance (MTG-Jamendo real-audio baseline wins∼59%{\sim}59\%附录中的比较of its comparisons in AppendixF）。剩下的训练对是人工智能与人工智能，因此学习的标量对于缩放真实音乐相对于人工智能的监督有限。 (ii) 偏好投票 TuneJury 从音乐性之外的权重因素（例如流派或乐器偏好）中获悉，而 PAM 的音乐性 MOS 则没有，因此这两个分数部分衡量的是不同的事物。). The remaining training pairs are AI vs. AI, so the learned scalar has limited supervision for scaling real music relative to AI. (ii) The preference votes TuneJury learns from weigh factors beyond musicality (e.g., genre or instrumentation preferences) that PAM’s musicality MOS does not, so the two scores partly measure different things.

5 应用：选择、推理时间优化和训练后Applications: Selection, Inference-Time Optimization, and Post-Training

除了基准准确性之外，我们还在三个下游应用程序中将 TuneJury 作为偏好对齐信号：推理时间选择、奖励驱动的潜在优化和专家迭代后训练。每个应用程序都会测试相同的冻结 TuneJury 是否可以使音乐生成管道与人类偏好保持一致。具体来说，模式 1（最好的Beyond benchmark accuracy, we exercise TuneJury as a preference-alignment signal in three downstream applications: inference-time selection, reward-driven latent optimization, and expert-iteration post-training. Each application tests whether the same frozen TuneJury can align a music generation pipeline with human preferences. Concretely, Mode 1 (best-of-NN选择）按奖励对冻结骨干候选者进行排名，模式 2（奖励驱动的潜在优化）通过 DITTO 反向传播selection) ranks frozen-backbone candidates by reward, Mode 2 (reward-driven latent optimization) backpropagates through DITTO[50]进入噪声潜伏，模式 3（专家迭代）根据其自己的最高奖励十分位数微调主干网。into the noise latents, and Mode 3 (expert iteration) fine-tunes the backbone on its own top-reward decile.

模式 3 使用公开发布的 FluxAudio-S 检查点 (Mode 3 post-trains the backbone weights themselves against TuneJury reward, using the publicly released FluxAudio-S checkpoint (∼120{\sim}120M 整流流 DiT atM rectified-flow DiT at1616千赫兹；kHz;fluxaudio_s_full.pth来自 MeanAudio 版本from the MeanAudio release[36]) 在专家迭代下) under expert iteration[2, 57]关于模型自己的输出。每轮生成on the model’s own outputs. Each round generates900900候选人（candidates (99每个 SDD 的噪声种子noise seeds per SDD-100100提示），用 TuneJury 对其进行评分，保留最高奖励十分位（prompt), scores them with TuneJury, retains the top reward decile (9090样本），并对这些进行微调samples), and fine-tunes on those9090独自为alone for55K 次迭代。微调步骤中没有混合任何外部数据，因此唯一的训练信号是 FluxAudio-S 预训练先验之上的自过滤专家集。我们选择专家迭代而不是扩散侧策略梯度（DDPOK iterations. No external data is mixed in at the fine-tune step, so the only training signal is the self-filtered expert set on top of the FluxAudio-S pretraining prior. We choose expert iteration over diffusion-side policy gradient (DDPO[3], GRPO [56]）因为它是离线的并且与模型无关：循环只需要采样、评分、过滤和监督微调，不需要通过去噪链进行在线强化学习。相反，策略梯度必须修改采样器以跟踪每步操作对数概率。完整的超参数和推理配置出现在附录中) because it is offline and model-agnostic: the loop requires only sampling, scoring, filtering, and supervised fine-tuning, with no online reinforcement learning through the denoising chain. Policy gradient instead must modify the sampler to track per-step action log-probabilities. Full hyperparameters and the inference configuration appear in AppendixH.

奖励利用是真实偏好信号的独立证据。Reward exploitation is independent evidence of a real preference signal.

TuneJury 优化下出现的奖励利用模式是 TuneJury 表现得像真正的偏好对齐信号的独立证据。随机噪声或与 MAD 或 CLAP 分数大致一致的指标都不会在奖励和分布保真度之间产生这种一致的差异，这是对有意义但不完美的代理进行奖励黑客攻击的经验特征The reward-exploitation pattern surfacing under TuneJury optimization is independent evidence that TuneJury behaves like a real preference-alignment signal. 7 结论Conclusion

我们发布We release曲调评审团TuneJury，一个开放的、实例级的成对音乐奖励模型，在来自四个开源来源的人类评分对上进行训练，没有伪标签增强。冻结音乐预训练编码器上的小型 MLP 头可推广到保留的测试对和分布外基准，与后者的伪增强 CMI-RM 基线保持竞争力。相同的冻结标量在开放权重主干上驱动三个下游应用程序，无需按模式调整：推理时间最佳, an open, instance-level pairwise music reward model trained on human-rated pairs from four open sources without pseudo-label augmentation. A small MLP head over frozen music-pretrained encoders generalizes to held-out test pairs and out-of-distribution benchmarks, staying competitive with the pseudo-augmented CMI-RM baseline on the latter. The same frozen scalar drives three downstream applications on open-weights backbones without per-mode tuning: inference-time best-of-NN选择、DITTO 式潜在优化和专家迭代后训练。专家迭代下的奖励保真度权衡是经典的奖励利用模式，独立证据表明 TuneJury 充当真正的偏好对齐信号，而不是噪音或侧面指标的琐碎重述。我们另外发布selection, DITTO-style latent optimization, and expert-iteration post-training. The reward-fidelity trade-off under expert iteration is the classic reward-exploitation pattern, independent evidence that TuneJury behaves as a genuine preference-alignment signal rather than noise or a trivial restatement of side metrics. We additionally release锚定标定anchor calibration，事后的、按系统的 Bradley-Terry 校准，使 TuneJury 适应新的 TTM 系统，其数据效率比再训练要高得多（附录, a post-hoc, per-system Bradley–Terry calibration that adapts TuneJury to new TTM systems at substantially better data efficiency than retraining (AppendixD）。所有工件（检查点、应用程序管道、校准代码、听力演示和七个开放集合的预先计算的分数）均在附录中发布和记录). All artifacts (checkpoints, application pipelines, calibration code, listening demos, and pre-computed scores on seven open collections) are released and documented in AppendixI.
